Every node on the grid still on an older release of an adapter this
catalog publishes - what a pull has left to be adopted.

The node-template counterpart to catalog_library_dependents, and asked at
the same moment: a pull can bring both, and neither takes effect on its
own. Answered from what is already on this grid, with no network - the
catalog's checkout only moves when it is pulled, so "newer release" here
means "you pulled, and this node hasn't caught up".

Projects the caller doesn't collaborate on are counted rather than listed.
